title: The Tokoloshe Water Spirit Legend
premise: In Nguni mythology, a mischievous dwarf-like water spirit called a tokoloshe is sent by a malevolent witch doctor to torment victims at night.
central_question: How do you protect yourself from the deadly nighttime attacks of the tokoloshe?
understanding_shift: The deadly midnight curse of the tokoloshe can be completely avoided simply by raising your bed off the ground.
ending_payoff: Elevating your bed with bricks remains the ultimate defense against the unseen nighttime visitor.
recurring_visual_motif: Stacked bricks beneath wooden bed legs
hook_overlay: Biting off sleeping people's toes in the dark.
